briefdescription.para: Stage an IN report in the HID Interrupt IN transmit buffer.

simplesect.para: Port-decoupled staging contract: copies up to SYN_USB_HID_MAX_REPORT_SIZE (64 B) into hid->tx_buf and sets hid->tx_len. The platform USB ISR transmits hid->tx_buf on hid->ep_in and invokes the class data_in callback upon completion to clear hid->tx_len (or advance a queued auto-release report).
SYN_OK on success, SYN_BUSY if a staged report is still pending.
